title: Death of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny in an Arctic penal colony
body:
Alexei Navalny, the Russian opposition politician, died on 16 February 2024 at the age of 47 in the FKU IK-3 penal colony in Kharp, in the Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug in Russia's Arctic. He was serving a sentence of 19 years. Russian prison authorities said he lost consciousness after a walk and could not be revived. At the time of his death he was in solitary confinement for the 27th time.

Russian officials attributed the death to a heart arrhythmia and a blood pressure episode. On 26 July 2024 Russia's Investigative Committee concluded that the death had no criminal nature and resulted from a combined disease. In April 2024 US intelligence agencies assessed that Vladimir Putin most likely did not order the death, an assessment that did not absolve him. Many Western governments, including those of Canada, Germany and the United Kingdom, blamed the Russian state, as did US President Joe Biden. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov called the accusations against Putin absolutely unfounded. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for a full investigation.

Authorities returned the body on 24 February. The funeral took place on 1 March 2024 at a church in Moscow's Maryino district, and he was buried at Borisovskoye Cemetery. According to OVD-Info, 128 people were arrested in 19 cities on the day of the funeral.
